name: jevguard
description: Verifies that the agent follows the project's rules through a System One model: blocks tool calls, edits, or the final response when a rule fails.

jev_api_key.title: Jev API key
jev_api_key.description: Bearer token for the Jev verification backend (https://docs.typesafe.ai). Stored securely, never written to a project file. Leave empty for a local backend that doesn't require auth.

jev_base_url.title: Jev backend URL
jev_base_url.description: Base URL of the Jev-compatible verification backend.
